conclusion: No genotype-specific sequential structure detected beyond block-conditional choice probabilities

analysis.filter: 0% contrast trials in biased blocks only

surrogate_method: Block-aware: preserves block-transition sequence, iid choices within blocks at per-animal per-block P(left). 100 iterations for L=4 comparisons, 20 for L=6.
interpretation: The block-aware iid model fully accounts for all CBAS hits. No evidence of higher-order sequential structure beyond what stationary per-block choice probabilities produce. Consistent with Noel finding that the exponential-weighting model with stationary parameters is sufficient. With n=15/group and criterion=600, CBAS likely lacks power to detect subtle trial-to-trial dependencies even if present.
